articles.title: The most dramatic meteor shower of the summer peaks the day of a solar eclipse - NBC News
articles.description: The Perseids’ peak coincides with another highly anticipated celestial event: a total solar eclipse that will be visible in parts of Europe.
articles.content:
One of the years brightest and most popular meteor showers peaks this week, offering a chance to see shooting stars cross a particularly dark sky, thanks to the new moon.
